notes: Thin run: Bolivian clinics mostly publish on Facebook only. Refused: bagheeravet.com (robots_disallowed), facebook.com/EmervetBo (robots_disallowed), crovethospitalveterinario.com (client_error), vetshunter.com (bot wall). WebFetch also refused (provenance) www.uagrm.edu.bo, veterinariasudamericana.com and the NaturalVet negocio.site page, which were not circumvented. Not found: Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios Zootecnistas directory (no official site surfaced), SENASAG list, university clinic pages (UAGRM, UMSA, UMSS), duty rota (veterinario de turno), animal poison line (none found). Not added for lack of phone/url on an opened page: Clinica Veterinaria Municipal Cochabamba (La Chimba, Mon-Fri 8-16). Leads left to verify: Emervet (Santa Cruz), EVET Emergencias Veterinarias and Umevet (Cochabamba), Urgencias Veterinarias (La Paz), Veterinaria La Quinta, Animalia, San Roque, Vet-Salud, Animal House (Santa Cruz), Clinica Veterinaria Sudamericana (veterinariasudamericana.com), Bagheera (Cochabamba). Sucre, Tarija, Oruro, Uyuni: nothing found.
